name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
summary: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year to farmer families, paid in three equal instalments.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year (₹2,000 every 4 months) directly to the bank account.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Gramin (PMAY-G)
summary: Financial assistance for building a pucca house for rural households that are houseless or live in kutcha or dilapidated houses.
benefits: ₹1,20,000 in plains and ₹1,30,000 in hilly or difficult areas for house construction.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Urban (PMAY-U)
summary: Affordable housing for urban households through interest subsidy on home loans and direct assistance.
benefits: Interest subsidy on home loans for eligible EWS and LIG households.
documents: Affidavit of not owning a pucca house
notes: Income categories and subsidy rates have changed between scheme phases. Check the current guidelines on the official site.

name: Ayushman Bharat – Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
summary: Health cover of ₹5 lakh per family per year for hospitalisation at empanelled hospitals.
benefits: ₹5,00,000 health cover per family per year at empanelled hospitals.
notes: Citizens aged 70 and above are covered under a separate expansion of this scheme irrespective of income. Check the official site.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
summary: Free LPG connection for adult women from poor households.
benefits: Free LPG connection with financial support for the stove and first refill.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
summary: Government-backed savings scheme for the girl child with a government-set interest rate and tax benefits.
benefits: Government-set interest rate and tax-free maturity. Minimum deposit ₹250 and maximum ₹1,50,000 per year.
documents: Birth certificate of the girl child
notes: An account can be opened for a girl child below 10 years of age. A family can open accounts for up to two daughters in most cases.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
summary: Collateral-free loans up to ₹10 lakh for micro and small enterprises.
benefits: Shishu: up to ₹50,000. Kishore: ₹50,001 to ₹5,00,000. Tarun: ₹5,00,001 to ₹10,00,000. No collateral required.
notes: Loans are for non-farm income-generating activities and allied agricultural activities.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
summary: Guaranteed monthly pension after age 60 for workers in the unorganised sector.
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 after age 60, depending on the contribution.
documents: Mobile number linked to the bank account

apply.channel: Any bank branch or net banking

name: PM Vishwakarma
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises
summary: End-to-end support for traditional artisans and craftspeople through skills, tools, credit and market access.
benefits: Skills training with a daily stipend, a toolkit incentive, and collateral-free loans at a concessional interest rate.
documents: Proof of trade (self-declaration or panchayat certificate)

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
summary: Monthly pension for senior citizens aged 60 and above from households below the poverty line.
benefits: Central assistance every month. Many states add a top-up on this amount.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
summary: Cash incentive for pregnant women and lactating mothers for the first living child.
benefits: ₹5,000 in instalments for the first child. A further benefit applies for a second child if it is a girl.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC/Minority Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice / Ministry of Tribal Affairs / Ministry of Minority Affairs
summary: Scholarships for students from disadvantaged communities pursuing education after Class 10.
benefits: Covers course fees and maintenance allowance. The amount varies by course and category.
notes: Students from minority communities may also qualify under the minority scholarship schemes. Check the official portal.

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
benefits: Collateral-free working-capital loans in stages, with interest subsidy and incentives for digital transactions.
documents: Vending certificate or letter of recommendation from the urban local body

name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)
ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution
summary: Free foodgrain for priority households and Antyodaya families under the National Food Security Act.
benefits: Free foodgrain every month for priority households and Antyodaya (AAY) households.
documents: List of family members on the ration card

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
summary: Monthly pension for widows aged 40 to 79 from households below the poverty line.
benefits: Central assistance every month. Many states add a top-up on this amount.
